title: Research note: exact R420 quad4 cleanup envelope
body:
## Status

Research note: exact finite secondary-cost enumeration. No new κ claim.

## Finding

For the fixed six-register positive transfer from PR1058, the inverse-subtraction DAG contains 1,768 minimum-length (11-ADD) words. Enumerating every such word yields five distinct reverse-positive cleanup matrices. The predecessor word has maximum row-sum amplification 11; two alternative shortest words attain 9. Each occurs in 630 shortest words. The other three matrices have maxima 11, 15, and 15.

This optimum is only among shortest positive-addition words. The absolute-inverse lower bound has maximum row sum 7, so the search does not settle longer words. The result does not claim a global paid-bill improvement or a change in κ.

## Reproduce

From the repository root (Python 3.9+, standard library only):

```sh
python3 -B research/r420-quad4-cleanup-frontier/analyze.py
```

Expected status: `PASS_R420_QUAD4_SHORTEST_CLEANUP_ENUMERATION`. The script validates the frozen input SHA-256 pins, recomputes all 165,828 DAG states and 917,020 legal edges, matches the predecessor's distance histogram and digest, replays all 1,768 forward witnesses and cleanup matrices, and checks two malformed-word controls. `RESULT.json` contains the full five-matrix envelope and witnesses.

## Pins and limits

- Base commit: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`.
- Predecessor: PR1058 head `d148d200f2d64c90504fa3a9608e455aaa4c0c21`.
- Domain: the pinned exact nonnegative integer transfer on six ordered registers, with `dst += src`, distinct registers, no auxiliaries, permutations, or subtraction.
- The selected record and its inherited supplier and assembly assumptions are unchanged. No whole-word native replay or new multiplication exponent is claimed.

PR1058 supplies the fixed construction and complete gate-minimum DAG. This contribution adds the exact cleanup-amplification envelope over its shortest factorizations. The predecessor construction is credited to Chris Barber (@cbarber1), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. This note also used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed. The package includes the applicable Apache-2.0 license.
